{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too low during uptrends, showing 0.3-0.6 euro lag behind true prices",
    "When price is below 63 euro, model underforecasts by 0.2-0.4 euro due to mean-reversion bias",
    "High sentiment (0.67+), 0.3-0.6 euro daily price moves, or 3+ consecutive price increases amplify forecast errors by 0.1-0.3 euro",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative corrects 0.1-0.2 euro of forecast bias within 1-2 day lag",
    "Model peaks are consistently 0.2-0.4 euro below true peaks, especially when sentiment is strong",
    "When price has been flat for 4+ days, model underforecasts current levels by 0.1-0.2 euro as it can't capture trading range dynamics",
    "Sentiment aligns with price direction but lags by 1-2 days, causing forecast misalignment with near-term price momentum"
] }
